channel.title: Stacked After Dark
channel.description: Maya and Rob on the things we build after work builds us down. New episodes most Tuesdays.

item.title: Ep. 016 — Shipping on a Deadline You Invented
item.description: Maya and Rob dig into self-imposed deadlines: why fake urgency works on real brains, and how Rob shipped his side project by telling four friends a launch date he made up on the spot.

item.title: Ep. 017 — The Backlog Is a Graveyard and That's Fine
item.description: Maya and Rob make peace with the backlog. Every idea you file away is a tiny funeral, and the healthiest builders hold the service and move on instead of promising resurrection.
